units.source_text: 举行祖母葬礼那年，我已上小学。

en.t: The year my grandmother's funeral was held, I had already started elementary school.

units.source_text: 祖母同祖父两人抚育我这个孱弱的孙子，好容易才熬到送孙子上学，刚松一口气，她却猝然长逝了。

en.t: My grandmother and grandfather had raised me, their frail grandson, and had only just managed to see me off to school and breathe a sigh of relief when she suddenly passed away.

units.source_text: 举行葬礼那天，倾盆大雨，我由一个经常进出我家的汉子背着去墓地。

en.t: On the day of the funeral, rain poured down in torrents, and a man who often came in and out of our house carried me on his back to the graveyard.

units.source_text: 十二岁的姐姐身穿白衣，也是由大人背着，在我前面登上了红土的山路走去的。

en.t: My twelve-year-old sister, dressed in white, was also carried on an adult's back and went ahead of me up the red-clay mountain path.
